tasks.name: Material Library
tasks.objective: Produce the Material Library for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Each material lists its maps, resolution, texel density and licence
Seamless tiling verified on a test plane
Every material parameter exposed to the shader is documented

tasks.name: Texture Budget and Compression Plan
tasks.objective: Produce the Texture Budget and Compression Plan for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Texture memory measured per platform profile
Compression format chosen per map type with rationale
Any texture over budget has a downscale or atlas plan
